title: Pan-Seared Mediterranean Paella Cakes
description: A twist on traditional paella, these crispy cakes are packed with juicy Mediterranean flavors and perfect for a quick dinner or snack.
instructions: 2. In a medium bowl, mix together the crushed Mediterranean paella, flaked fish, beaten eggs, minced garlic, diced tomatoes, salt, and pepper.
3. Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts and shape each part into a round cake.
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
5. Add 2 paella cakes to the skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side, until golden brown.
6. Transfer the cakes to a baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 10-12 minutes.
7. Repeat with the remaining paella cakes.
